北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 霾天，注意防护，出门记得戴口罩哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy, remember to protect yourself and wear a mask when going out!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天湿度大，感觉闷热，注意开窗通风哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with high humidity, it feels muggy, remember to ventilate.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉湿度高，出门带伞，备件薄外套。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, cool, and humid; bring an umbrella and a light jacket.
上海.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天风力大，湿度高体感闷热，多喝水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, windy, and high humidity makes it feel stuffy, drink more water.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感热，湿度大易出汗，记得多补水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels hot, high humidity leads to sweating, remember to hydrate.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天有风微凉，出门注意防风，避免着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool with wind, watch out for wind and avoid catching a cold.
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感偏热，清淡饮食，保持好心情哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels a bit warm, eat light and keep a good mood.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天温度适中，户外散步，享受舒适天气。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with moderate temperatures, enjoy a comfortable walk outdoors.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天湿度 90%，衣服易粘腻，注意除湿哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with 90% humidity, clothes might feel sticky, consider dehumidifying.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨湿冷，记得带伞加衣，小心别淋湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and damp cold, remember an umbrella and extra layers, don't get wet.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 多云有风，早晚温差大，记得及时添衣哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and windy, big temperature swings between day and night, dress accordingly.
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 多云有风体感凉，出门记得添件薄外套。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and windy, feels cool, remember to wear a light jacket when going out.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗天气好，阳光正好，适合户外活动哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant weather, perfect for outdoor activities.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗天气舒适，享受春城，别辜负好时光。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and comfortable weather, enjoy the Spring City and make the most of it.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 大雾弥漫能见度低，开车朋友请慢行注意。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog and low visibility, drivers please proceed slowly and cautiously.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 浓雾笼罩体感寒凉，风大，记得防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog makes it feel cold, it's windy, remember to protect from wind and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大雾弥漫体感寒凉，注意交通安全，添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog makes it feel cold, be careful with traffic and dress warmly.
